title: Peak+
description: An assortment of QoL, Visual, World-Gen, and Performance mods that add to the vanilla experience.
body:
This Modpack includes performance, visual, worldgen, and QoL mods and resource packs that culminate in the PEAK Vanilla+ Experience.



Not for use on public servers.

I am working on a ServerPack for this.



Thank you to the creators of all the mods and resource packs included. They do fantastic work, check them out.
